componentSpecs.name: EmptyState (Timeline Comments)
componentSpecs.description: Empty state component displayed when a video has comments but no timeline comments (comments with timestamps) are visible in the current view mode. This provides clear feedback and educational guidance to users.
componentSpecs.location: ChzzkYoutubeConverterTab.tsx, lines 863-867 (to be replaced with conditional rendering)
visualHierarchy: Primary message: '이 영상에는 타임스탬프가 포함된 댓글이 없습니다.' (14px)
Educational tip: '💡 타임라인 댓글은 댓글 내용에 00:00 형식의 타임스탬프가 포함된 댓글입니다.' (14px, subtle styling)

accessibility.screenReaderText: 이 영상에는 타임라인 댓글이 없습니다. 타임라인 댓글은 댓글 내용에 00:00 형식의 타임스탬프가 포함된 댓글입니다.

layoutStructure.container: Centered flex column layout within the comments section card

designNotes: This empty state is ONLY shown when comments exist but none are timeline comments (have timestamps)
The existing EmptyState component at lines 863-867 already provides the correct structure
The educational tip text should be added as an additional element below the EmptyState component
Maintain consistency with existing empty states (e.g., lines 616-620 for no videos)
The icon used is ChatBubbleLeftIcon from @heroicons/react/24/outline (already imported at line 14)
The component must respect the theme toggle and display correct colors for both light and dark modes
Animation properties inherit from EmptyState component (motion.div with initial/animate states)
The conditional rendering ensures this state never conflicts with the 'no comments at all' scenario
The educational tip helps users understand what timeline comments are, improving UX and reducing confusion

interactionStates.default: Static display with no interactive elements
interactionStates.animation: Fade-in on mount using Framer Motion (opacity 0→1, translateY 10→0, duration 0.3s)

mobile.fontSize: Base size reduced by 14/16 ratio (see globals.css lines 42-50)
mobile.padding: Maintains py-12 px-6 from EmptyState component

testingConsiderations: Test with screen readers to ensure ARIA attributes are properly announced
Verify message displays when toggling between original and converted comment views
Confirm empty state does NOT appear when comments.length === 0 (entire comments section hidden)
Test both light and dark theme rendering
Check text wrapping on narrow viewports
Verify emoji (💡) displays correctly across browsers
